title: How to restart the service on watch
body:
I would like to use my TicWatch as standalone collector. I use Libre sensor and miaomiao. I set it up from phone and all worked fine.
But, if I turn off the watch (I use it only during sport activities), when I turn it on again xdrip doesn't work. I'm not able to re-start the service, I tried every option. The only way is to disable and re-enable the smartwatch from xdrip installed on the phone I used to configure it. SInce this is no my phone and I haven't an Android phone where I can install xdrip, I ask you how to restart the data collection on my watch without a phone.
Thanks
Giulia

comments.body: There's a few things. Did you enable as collector and then force as collector? After this, there's 2 settings in the top row in the xdrip watchface when you press the three dots in the left corner - database refresh and restart collector - hit both those icons twice and it should refresh - wait for the next 5 min interval and you should see your readings sync if not immediately.

Yes, enable as collector and then force as collector are selected. I tried
also database refresh and restart collector, but with no results.
p.s. whats do you mean by "hit them twice"? Like a mouse double click?

Today I turned on the watch after 2 days, with no phone paired with it, and
it worked correctly showing my actual BG. After that I did some tests: I
turned on an off the bluetooth and/or restarted the watch, and I was not
able to have it working any more. I hit "database refresh and restart
collector" and rebooted the watch, but it is still not working.

I really have no idea.

Thanks
Giulia
